read_spreadsheet_excel: read an Excel spreadsheet file using pl.read_excel with calamine engine and sheet_name parameter
read_spreadsheet_ods: read an OpenDocument spreadsheet file using pl.read_ods with sheet_id parameter
read_multiple_worksheets: read multiple worksheets from a spreadsheet by specifying sheet_name list or sheet_id list
read_multiple_workbooks: read multiple spreadsheet workbooks at once with include_file_paths parameter
read_all_sheets: read all sheets from a spreadsheet file by setting sheet_id to 0
read_excel_round_trip: write a DataFrame to Excel with write_excel and read it back with pl.read_excel for verification
read_excel_temporal_data: read Excel temporal columns with schema_overrides for datetime date and time types
read_excel_with_schema_overrides: read an Excel file with schema_overrides to enforce specific column dtypes
read_excel_with_read_options: read an Excel file passing engine-specific options through read_options parameter
write_excel_formatting: write a DataFrame to Excel with custom formatting table styles and conditional formats
write_excel_sparklines: write a DataFrame to Excel with sparklines for trend visualization across columns
write_excel_column_row_totals: write a DataFrame to Excel with column_totals and row_totals formula columns
write_excel_compound_types: write a DataFrame with Array and List compound types to an Excel worksheet
write_excel_named_table: write a DataFrame to Excel as a named table with column_totals total row
write_excel_freeze_panes: write a DataFrame to Excel with freeze_panes to lock header rows or columns
